svg.title: T3 Code: original production versus Rust port
svg.desc: Six paired benchmark charts. Warm desktop visibility 1.65 times faster, fresh backend accepted-command readiness 40.4 times faster, and idle backend plus native monitor sum RSS about 90 percent lower.
svg.text: Original production build vs the current Rust port
Apple M4 · 32 GiB RAM · macOS 27 · 10 rounds per runtime / condition · medians
Backend: all providers disabled; fresh app state; OS caches not cleared; both include the same native monitor.
Desktop: disconnected UI-only visibility lifecycle; not first paint, usable UI, or total app startup.
RPC medians pool 1,000 reads; thread creates pool 300 writes. sum RSS may count shared pages twice.
